additional_info.subject: Status update - Feedback from R&D
additional_info.body:
Our team together with R&D has been actively investigating and addressing connectivity issues with the impacted chargers, particularly those running Firmware 7, when connecting to AWS IoT Core. The core challenge identified is high latency impacting reliable communication.
Key Findings & Troubleshooting:
Latency Sensitivity
: R&D team has determined that a latency exceeding +325 ms is problematic for AWS IoT Core (our MQTT service connecting chargers to SCB). Notably, Firmware 7 appears to be more sensitive to this latency compared to Firmware 6.
Testing Environment
: R&D team has successfully deployed a separate SSH tunnel on a charger in the YHI warehouse for testing purposes.
AWS Region Impact:
Initial tests showed high latency.
Creating an AWS IoT Core endpoint in Sydney significantly reduced latency to approximately ~25 ms, which worked successfully with our test client.
AWS Support & Alternatives:
An AWS support ticket was opened to explore solutions.
AWS Global Accelerator was initially suggested, but it's deemed too complex for the given scopes.
Current Approach & Next Steps:
Lightweight PoC (Proof of Concept): R&D team is moving forward with a more lightweight solution to address the latency.
Solution Rollout: If this PoC is successful, we will have a viable solution ready for broader deployment.
Latest Development & Status:
SDK Re-implementation: After exploring and finding AWS infrastructure-side solutions too complex, R&D team opted to re-implement the aws-iot-device-sdk. This re-implementation is currently functional but requires further refinement.
Firmware 7.0.5 Backport: R&D team is working on creating a production-ready backport for Firmware v7.0.5. The current fix is working locally (R&D test machine), and we might anticipate a proper release (either as a hotfix or a new v7 version) within a few days. This will also pave the way for a v8 release.
Dependency Resolution: We are addressing some dependency issues related to building the older v7 version, which are expected to be resolved very soon.
Future Alignment: Once a production-ready artifact is available, R&D teams will coordinate internally to plan the subsequent steps. These will be communicated to Service teams accordingly
